sextile: Of or denoting the aspect or position of any two celestial bodies separated by 60°.
sextillion: A trillion billion: 1 followed by 21 zeros, 10²¹.
sexto: A book consisting of sheets each of which is folded into six leaves.
sextodecimo: A size of a sheet of paper resulting from folding and cutting a sheet of paper into sixteenths (3.25"–5" x 5"–6.25").
sexton: A church official who looks after a church building and its graveyard and may act as a gravedigger and bell ringer.
sextupled: simple past and past participle of sextuple
sextuplicate: Six times the number, volume, length, etc.
sextuplicated: simple past and past participle of sextuplicate
sextuplicating: present participle and gerund of sextuplicate
sextupling: present participle and gerund of sextuple
sexual: Arising from the fact of being male or female; pertaining to sex or gender, or to the social relations between the sexes.
sexuality: The quality of being sexual; that which is characterized or distinguished by sex.
sexualization: The act or process of sexualizing.
sexualize: To render sexual, or apply sex appeal to (a person, thing, or concept).
sexualizes: third-person singular simple present indicative of sexualize
sexualizing: present participle and gerund of sexualize
